9558.finding: The FIA classification lists Hamilton first, Verstappen second and Norris third.
The official race report describes Hamilton's victory in a race affected by changing weather.
Mercedes describes watching the weather radar and reports Hamilton rejoining behind Norris and ahead of Verstappen at the intermediate-tyre stop.

9590.finding: The FIA provisional classification lists Leclerc first, Piastri second and Norris third.
The F1 race report describes Leclerc winning on a one-stop strategy, ahead of Piastri and Norris.
McLaren reports that Norris pitted on laps 14 and 32 and Piastri on laps 16 and 38. The team said it chose two stops because of tyre concerns; this is the team's explanation.

9636.finding: The FIA classification lists Verstappen first, Ocon second and Gasly third.
The FIA report describes Verstappen winning from 17th on the grid and a race affected by rain and a red flag.
The official F1 report describes changing weather and Verstappen's recovery to win from 17th.
